manifest.name: Paper
manifest.description: A warm editorial language: off-white paper, near-black ink, a deep teal accent and almost square corners.

widget.doc: A button on the control scale: primary (one per view), secondary, outline, ghost or destructive. Fires onPressed.

props.doc: primary fills with the brand color; secondary a strong neutral; outline a hairline; ghost nothing; destructive red.
The control scale: xs 24 (rows, dense panels), compact 28 (the default), small 32, medium 36, large 44.
A Material icon name shown before the label (empty: none).

widget.doc: A square icon-only button on the control scale: ghost (the default), outline or primary. Fires onPressed.

props.doc: ghost: nothing until hovered; outline: a hairline; primary: the brand fill.
The control scale: xs 24 (rows, dense panels), compact 28 (the default), small 32, medium 36, large 44.

widget.doc: A one-line text field on the control scale (28 by default), its value kept in your variable. Fires onChanged and onSubmitted.

props.doc: The name of your text variable: the field shows it and writes it as the user types.
Draws the error border (the message goes under it: a Field's error).

widget.doc: A multi-line text field (a note, a message), styled as TextInput, its value kept in your variable. Fires onChanged.

props.doc: The name of your text variable.

widget.doc: A dropdown of options on the control scale, the choice kept in your variable. Fires onChanged.

props.doc: The name of your text variable holding the chosen option.

widget.doc: A check box with an optional label, its value kept in your variable. Fires onChanged.

props.doc: The name of your boolean variable.

widget.doc: One option of a group: selected while your variable holds its value; tapping sets it. Fires onChanged.

props.doc: The name of your text variable holding the group's chosen value.

widget.doc: An on/off toggle with an optional label, its value kept in your variable. Fires onChanged.

props.doc: The name of your boolean variable.

widget.doc: A value between min and max, dragged, kept in your variable. Fires onChanged.

props.doc: The name of your number variable.
Steps between min and max (0: continuous).

widget.doc: Two to five mutually exclusive options in one control (a view switch, a period), the choice in your variable. Fires onChanged.

props.doc: The name of your text variable holding the chosen option.
The control scale: xs 24 (rows, dense panels), compact 28 (the default), small 32, medium 36, large 44.

widget.doc: A row of tabs over a panel, the current one in your variable; show the panel for it yourself. Fires onChanged.

props.doc: The name of your text variable holding the current tab.

bind.decoration.fills[0].color: ${= props.tone == 'neutral' ? theme.colors.neutralTint : (props.tone == 'primary' ? theme.colors.primaryTint : (props.tone == 'success' ? theme.colors.successTint : (props.tone == 'warning' ? theme.colors.warningTint : (props.tone == 'error' ? theme.colors.errorTint : theme.colors.infoTint))))}
bind.decoration.strokes[0].color: ${= props.tone == 'neutral' ? theme.colors.neutralTintBorder : (props.tone == 'primary' ? theme.colors.primaryTintBorder : (props.tone == 'success' ? theme.colors.successTintBorder : (props.tone == 'warning' ? theme.colors.warningTintBorder : (props.tone == 'error' ? theme.colors.errorTintBorder : theme.colors.infoTintBorder))))}

bind.decoration.fills[0].color: ${= props.tone == 'neutral' ? theme.colors.secondaryText : (props.tone == 'primary' ? theme.primary : (props.tone == 'success' ? theme.success : (props.tone == 'warning' ? theme.warning : (props.tone == 'error' ? theme.error : theme.colors.info))))}

bind.props.style.color: ${= props.tone == 'neutral' ? theme.colors.secondaryText : (props.tone == 'primary' ? theme.primary : (props.tone == 'success' ? theme.success : (props.tone == 'warning' ? theme.warning : (props.tone == 'error' ? theme.error : theme.colors.info))))}

widget.doc: A small status or count label: tinted, 20 px high, radius 5 (a pill for counts), as wide as its text.

props.doc: neutral, primary, success, warning, error or info: a 10 % tint, a matching hairline, the tone's ink.
A 6 px dot of the tone before the text (a status).
Fully rounded (a count); rounded corners (radius 5) otherwise.

widget.doc: A compact label: a tag, a filter (selected or not) or a removable value. Fires onPressed and onRemove.

props.doc: The active tint and primary text (a filter that is on).
An x after the label that fires onRemove.
A Material icon name before the label (empty: none).

widget.doc: A bordered panel: an optional header (title, subtitle, trailing actions) over its body (the call's children).

props.doc: Floats over content: shadow level 1 (cards are flat by default).

widget.doc: A dialog's frame for a modal canvas: title, optional description, body (the call's children) and footer actions. Fires onClose.

props.doc: A close button in the header (fires onClose).

bind.decoration.fills[0].color: ${= props.tone == 'neutral' ? theme.colors.neutralTint : (props.tone == 'primary' ? theme.colors.primaryTint : (props.tone == 'success' ? theme.colors.successTint : (props.tone == 'warning' ? theme.colors.warningTint : (props.tone == 'error' ? theme.colors.errorTint : theme.colors.infoTint))))}
bind.decoration.strokes[0].color: ${= props.tone == 'neutral' ? theme.colors.neutralTintBorder : (props.tone == 'primary' ? theme.colors.primaryTintBorder : (props.tone == 'success' ? theme.colors.successTintBorder : (props.tone == 'warning' ? theme.colors.warningTintBorder : (props.tone == 'error' ? theme.colors.errorTintBorder : theme.colors.infoTintBorder))))}

bind.props.color: ${= props.tone == 'neutral' ? theme.colors.secondaryText : (props.tone == 'primary' ? theme.primary : (props.tone == 'success' ? theme.success : (props.tone == 'warning' ? theme.warning : (props.tone == 'error' ? theme.error : theme.colors.info))))}

widget.doc: An inline message (info, success, warning, error): the tone's tint, icon and an optional action (the actions slot). Fires onDismiss.

props.title: Payment failed
props.message: Update your card to keep your plan.

widget.doc: A person or workspace: initials in a circle, or a photo.
How far something has got: a 4 px bar, value from 0 to 1, in the brand color or a tone.
One row of a list or table-like list: icon, title, optional subtitle and trailing content (the trailing slot). Fires onPressed.

props.doc: A Material icon name before the text (empty: none).

widget.doc: A form field's frame: a label above the control (the call's child), and a help or error line under it.

props.doc: A hint under the control (empty: none).
An error under the control, instead of the help (empty: none); pass error: true to the control too.
A required mark after the label.

widget.doc: A 36 px header over a list or panel: title, optional count badge and trailing actions (the actions slot).

props.doc: A count shown in a badge after the title (empty: none).

widget.doc: What a list or page shows when there is nothing yet (or nothing found): icon, title, message and an action (the actions slot).

props.doc: One or two sentences: what to do next.

props.title: No invoices yet
props.message: Invoices appear here once you bill a customer.

widget.doc: The tooltip bubble: inverted surface, radius 5, 11.5 px text and an optional shortcut; for a hover hint on a node use its tooltip behavior.

props.doc: A key hint after the text (empty: none).

widget.doc: A live state at a glance: a glowing dot (success, warning, error, info, neutral) with an optional label.

props.doc: success (green), error (red), warning and info (blue), neutral (grey).

widget.doc: A count beside a title or tab: a 16 px grey pill, 10/600. Above max it reads "max+".

bind.decoration.fills[0].color: ${= props.tone == 'neutral' ? theme.colors.neutralTint : (props.tone == 'primary' ? theme.colors.primaryTint : (props.tone == 'success' ? theme.colors.successTint : (props.tone == 'warning' ? theme.colors.warningTint : (props.tone == 'error' ? theme.colors.errorTint : theme.colors.infoTint))))}
bind.decoration.strokes[0].color: ${= props.tone == 'neutral' ? theme.colors.neutralTintBorder : (props.tone == 'primary' ? theme.colors.primaryTintBorder : (props.tone == 'success' ? theme.colors.successTintBorder : (props.tone == 'warning' ? theme.colors.warningTintBorder : (props.tone == 'error' ? theme.colors.errorTintBorder : theme.colors.infoTintBorder))))}

bind.props.style.color: ${= props.tone == 'neutral' ? theme.colors.secondaryText : (props.tone == 'primary' ? theme.primary : (props.tone == 'success' ? theme.success : (props.tone == 'warning' ? theme.warning : (props.tone == 'error' ? theme.error : theme.colors.info))))}

widget.doc: A run or sync state as a small pill in its tone: neutral, success, warning, error or info.

props.doc: neutral (unknown, skipped), success (done, synced), warning (pending, stale), error (failed, blocked), info (active, generated).

widget.doc: One small figure with its icon (files, lines, stars): a muted 11 px icon and a bold 10.5 px value.
A dashboard figure: a small labeled icon line over a large value, in a bordered tile.
A tinted square holding an icon, for a dialog or card header: 30 px, radius 7, the brand color at 10 %.
A setting with its switch: a bold title, an optional muted description, the switch at the end. Fires onChanged.

props.doc: The name of your boolean variable.

props.label: Watch for changes
props.description: Re-index when a file is saved.

widget.doc: A grey placeholder for content still loading: a line of text, a block or a circle, gently pulsing.
A failure under a card or row: a red rule over a one-line message with an alert icon. Fires onPressed.
One line of a feature list: a muted icon and a sentence.

props.default: Indexes your files as they change.

props.text: Indexes your files as they change.

widget.doc: A small titled section: an uppercase 11 px label over its content (the call's children), actions at the end of the header.
When and which revision, in one muted line: a clock with an age, then a branch icon with a commit.

props.doc: The branch icon in the success color.

widget.doc: A text link in the brand color, underlined; it opens its URL. Fires onPressed.

props.doc: Where it goes (empty: only onPressed fires).
An "open in new" icon after the text.

widget.doc: A count or a dot on the corner of what it wraps (an icon button, an avatar): red by default, hidden at zero.

props.doc: The number (0 hides it unless showZero).
A plain 8 px dot instead of the number.

widget.doc: Work in progress with no percentage: three small dots pulsing one after another.
A quiet "add another" under a list: a small muted icon and label, centered. Fires onPressed.
A small bordered pill for a row's action or state ("Add key", "Connected"). Fires onPressed.
Copies its text to the clipboard and shows a check for two seconds. Fires onCopy.

props.doc: A label ("Copy", then "Copied!") after the icon.

widget.doc: Goes back: a left arrow and a label. Fires onPressed.
A label over a field: the label, an optional description under it, then the call's children.

props.doc: A muted line under the label (empty: none).

widget.doc: A person, a bot or a team as a small pill: avatar and name. Fires onPressed and onRemove.

props.doc: A photo URL (empty: initials, or the kind's glyph).
human: photo or initials. bot: a bot glyph. team: an accent tile.
Muted words after the name ("· git").
An x at the end that fires onRemove.

widget.doc: A document, file, image, video, audio or link as a small bordered chip. Fires onPressed.

props.doc: Shorter (3 px above and below) and at most 190 wide, to sit in a line of text.

widget.doc: A file in a list: icon, name, then meta and actions at the end. Fires onPressed with the path.

props.doc: What to show (empty: the path's last part).

widget.doc: Where a job is, as one 15 px glyph: spinning while it runs, a check when done, an alert on error. Fires onPressed.

props.doc: setupNeeded, settingUp, synced, completion, running, paused or errored.

widget.doc: What a change did to files: +created, ~modified and -deleted counts as small colored chips after a file icon.
A bordered section with a header: a title, an optional icon and subtitle, the call's children below. Expandable opens and closes on its header. Fires onToggle.

props.doc: The header's title (empty and not expandable: no header).
A muted line under the title.
An icon before the title (empty: none).
default: a header over the content. expandable: the header opens and closes it. elevated: with a shadow.
Expandable: whether the content shows at first.

widget.doc: The foot of a long list: a "Load more" link, a spinner while it loads, Retry after an error, or the end's label. Fires onLoadMore.

props.doc: Why the last load failed (empty: it did not).
What to say when there is no more (empty: nothing).

widget.doc: Whether a live connection is up: a small plug in the state's color and its name.

props.doc: Other words than the state's own (empty: "Connected", "Reconnecting…"...).

widget.doc: A percent as a tiny ring with the number inside: red under 20, amber under 60, green above.

props.doc: Not counted yet: gray and dimmed.

widget.doc: A provider's logo on a small bordered plate, or its letter when there is no logo.

props.doc: The letter shown without a logo.
The letter's color (empty: the brand color).

widget.doc: The small square before an option in a menu or list: a logo, a letter or an icon.

props.doc: A logo's URL (empty: the icon, else the letter).
An icon on a subtle square (empty: the letter).
A letter, when there is neither.
The letter's color (empty: the brand color).

widget.doc: A service you connect to, as a row: its logo or letter, name and a dot for connected, a subtitle, and an action pill. Fires onAction.

props.doc: A green dot (else a gray one).
The logo's URL (empty: the name's first letter).

widget.doc: The strip of actions at the foot of a card: equal buttons split by hairlines. Fires onAction with the label.

props.doc: An icon for each (same order; none: no icons).

widget.doc: The path to this page: each level a link, the last one where you are. Fires onNavigate with the level's label ("Home" for the icon).

props.doc: A home icon before the first level.

widget.doc: Which page of several: small dots, the current one a wider brand bar. Fires onPageTapped with the index.
Progress through named steps: done steps checked, the current one ringed, the rest to come. Fires onStepPressed with the index.

props.doc: The current step, from 0 (the count: all done).
A muted line under each name (same order; none: no lines).

widget.doc: A number changed one step at a time: minus, the value, plus. The value is kept in your variable. Fires onChanged.

props.doc: The name of your number variable.
How much a press changes it.

widget.doc: A rounded search field with a search icon and a clear button, its text kept in your variable. Fires onChanged, onSubmitted and onClear.

props.doc: The name of your text variable.

widget.doc: Switches the site between light and dark: a moon in light mode, a sun in dark. Fires onChanged with the new mode.
Starts a download: a download icon with a label, or the icon alone. Fires onPressed.

props.doc: The words (empty: the icon alone, on a ghost button).
A spinner in the icon's place; no presses.

widget.doc: The call to upgrade a plan: a warm gradient button with a crown or sparkles. Fires onPressed.

props.doc: gradient: orange to pink. primary: solid orange.

widget.doc: A strip of labeled counts that filter the list under it; the active one is underlined. Fires onSelected with the label.

props.doc: A value after each name (same order).
A color for each value (same order; none: tertiary text).
The label of the filter in use.

widget.doc: The first-run panel: a hero icon, a title and subtitle, what you get as bullets, and one button. Fires onCta.

props.doc: What you get, one line each.
An icon for each line (same order; none: a check).
An icon in the button (empty: none).
A muted line under the button (empty: none).

props.title: Set up your workspace
props.subtitle: Connect a provider to start running agents.

widget.doc: A one-line notice attached to the top of a prompt box: credits left, a limit reached, read-only. Fires onPressed and onAction.

props.doc: info and neutral: plain. warning and critical: tinted.
An icon before the message (empty: none).
A link at the end ("Upgrade"); empty: none.

widget.doc: A job under way: a thin progress bar over pulsing dots, what it is doing and the percent.

bind.props.color: ${= props.state == 'synced' ? theme.success : (props.state == 'failed' ? theme.error : (props.state == 'pending' ? theme.warning : (props.state == 'unavailable' ? theme.colors.tertiaryText : theme.primary)))}

widget.doc: Whether something is saved to the cloud: a small cloud with a mark for synced, syncing, pending, failed or unavailable. Fires onPressed.

props.doc: checking, synced, syncing, pending, failed or unavailable.

widget.doc: A small heading that opens and closes what is under it (the call's children). Fires onToggle.

bind.props.style.color: ${= sum(props.counts) / max(1, props.total) >= 0.9 ? theme.success : (sum(props.counts) / max(1, props.total) >= 0.5 ? theme.primary : (sum(props.counts) / max(1, props.total) >= 0.25 ? theme.warning : theme.error))}

widget.doc: Progress made of parts: a bar with a colored segment per part, as wide as its count of the total, and the percent done.

props.doc: How many in each part (up to six parts).
A color for each part (same order).
The whole (what is not in a part is the empty track).
The percent done after the bar.

widget.doc: A choice between a few views as a pill track: the chosen one raised. The choice is kept in your variable. Fires onChanged.

props.doc: The name of your text variable holding the choice.

widget.doc: Open items as a row of small pills, the chosen one outlined; an optional add button. Fires onSelected with the label and onAdd.

props.doc: The name of your text variable holding the chosen label.

widget.doc: A menu (hamburger) button. Fires onPressed.

props.doc: xs, compact, small, medium or large.
False dims it and stops presses.

widget.doc: An action with a second half that opens its choices. Fires onPressed (the action) and onMenu (the chevron).

props.doc: The action's label (small shows the icon alone).
neutral: bordered. primary: filled with the brand color.
A spinner for the icon; both halves stop.
False dims it and stops presses.

widget.doc: The title bar of a document or a pane: an icon, a title and what the call puts at its end. Fires onTitle when the title is pressed.

props.doc: The icon before the title (empty: none).

widget.doc: A compact document object: a title bar over a content surface holding the call's children. Fires onOpen when the title is pressed.

props.doc: A muted line above the content.
gray: the soft secondary surface. white: a white page.

bind.decoration.fills[0].color: ${= (props.status == 'pending' || props.status == 'proposed') ? theme.colors.warningTint : ((props.status == 'approved' || props.status == 'confirmed' || props.status == 'promoted') ? theme.colors.successTint : (props.status == 'rejected' ? theme.colors.errorTint : theme.colors.tertiaryBackground))}

bind.props.style.color: ${= (props.status == 'pending' || props.status == 'proposed') ? theme.warning : ((props.status == 'approved' || props.status == 'confirmed' || props.status == 'promoted') ? theme.success : (props.status == 'rejected' ? theme.error : theme.colors.secondaryText))}

widget.doc: A text object: a titled bar with a status or date over a preview of the text. Instructions, notes, learnings. Fires onOpen.

props.doc: The text shown (five lines at most).
A muted context line above the text.
A status pill in the bar: pending, proposed, approved, confirmed, promoted, rejected or your own.
A date in the bar, shown in place of the status.
A kind after it, in monospace.
Shown when there is no text.

props.title: Tone of voice
props.value: Write plainly. Lead with the answer, then the reasons.

widget.doc: Code in monospace with a header: a title, a language tag and a copy button. Embedded drops the frame. Fires onCopy.

props.doc: A language tag in the header (empty: none).
A copy button in the header.
The body of a card around it: no border, no header, smaller type.

props.title: total.ts

bind.layout.flex: ${= max(1, round((props.total - min(props.completed, props.total)) * 1000 / max(1, props.total)))}

widget.doc: One operation over many items: its state, how many are done, a thin bar and a cancel button while it runs. Stack one per operation. Fires onCancel.

props.doc: What is running, shown while it does.
pending, uploading, complete, error or cancelled.
A cancel button while it uploads.

widget.doc: A helper at work as a small pill: its state, its name and an x to dismiss it. Fires onPressed and onDismiss.

props.doc: The label in the primary text color.

widget.doc: A row of a list you pick from: a title, a subtitle, a note at the end, selected or not. The call's children go under the text. Fires onSelected.

props.doc: The subtitle in monospace (a path, an id).
A short note at the end of the title's line (a time, a count).

widget.doc: Something you can act on, as a card: an icon panel, a title, a path and a note, with the call's actions at its end. Fires onPressed.

props.doc: A path or id under it, in monospace.

widget.doc: Facts about a file or a record as label and value rows, with an optional amber callout under them.

props.doc: A note in an amber box under the rows (empty: none).

props.callout: The template changed since this file was written.

widget.doc: One past run in a history: what ran, when, a message, what it changed and how it ended.

props.doc: A hairline over it (every row of a list but the first).

widget.doc: A bar telling how much of a trial is left, with an upgrade button and an x. Urgent turns it red. Fires onUpgrade and onDismiss.

props.doc: Red: the trial is about to end or has.

widget.doc: An invitation to sign in: an icon plate, a title, a line and a button, tinted in an accent. Fires onSignIn and onDismiss.

props.doc: Signing in: a spinner in the button.

widget.doc: The search row at the top of a list or a pane: edge to edge over a hairline. Its text is kept in your variable. Fires onChanged and onSubmitted.

props.doc: The name of your text variable.

widget.doc: A small search field for a header or a toolbar. Its text is kept in your variable. Fires onChanged and onSubmitted.

props.doc: The name of your text variable.

widget.doc: A sign-in form field: email, password or a code. Its text is kept in your variable; an error turns it red with the reason under it. Fires onChanged and onSubmitted.

props.doc: The name of your text variable.
email: the email keyboard. password: hidden text.

widget.doc: A number you type or step: a field with small up and down buttons, an optional prefix and suffix. The number is kept in your variable. Fires onChanged.

props.doc: The name of your number variable.
How much a step button changes it.
False dims it and stops input.

widget.doc: A color as its hex code, with a swatch of it. The code is kept in your variable. Fires onChanged, and onSwatch when the swatch is pressed.

props.doc: The name of your text variable holding the color (#RRGGBB).
False dims it and stops input.

widget.doc: Several people or models as small overlapping round plates with their first letters, and +n for the rest.

props.doc: Their names: each plate shows a first letter.
How many plates at most; the rest become +n.

widget.doc: The bar over a section: an icon, a title, a spinner while it loads, and the call's actions at the end.

props.doc: An icon before the title (empty: none).
A small spinner after the title.

widget.doc: The bar of a pane: an icon, a title, a muted note, the call's actions and a close button. Fires onTitle and onClose.

props.doc: A muted note after the title (a count, a branch).
An icon before the title (empty: none).
A small spinner after the title.
A close button at the end.

widget.doc: The app bar of a small window or a panel: a brand plate, a title over a status line, the call's actions at the end.

props.doc: A 5 px dot of this color before the status (empty: none).

bind.props.color: ${= props.status == 'running' ? theme.primary : (props.status == 'failed' ? theme.error : (props.status == 'ready' || props.status == 'passed' ? theme.success : theme.colors.tertiaryText))}

widget.doc: The header of a group of items in one state: a state icon, a label, how many, and a chevron that opens and closes the group. Fires onToggle.

props.doc: running, failed, idle, ready, passed or cancelled.

widget.doc: The full-width label over a group in a list: small upper-case letters on a soft band.
The small round button over a conversation or a log that takes it back to its end. Fires onPressed.
The tab bar at the foot of an app: icons over labels, with a badge on a tab that has news. The chosen tab is kept in your variable. Fires onChanged.

props.doc: One badge per tab: a count, a word, or empty for none.
The name of your text variable holding the chosen tab's label.
default: edge to edge under a hairline. floating: a rounded bar with a shadow.

widget.doc: The surface of a menu: bordered, rounded, with a shadow and an optional heading. Its children are MenuItem calls.

props.doc: A small heading over the items (empty: none).

widget.doc: A row of a MenuPopover: an icon, a title, an optional subtitle and a note at the end. Fires onSelected.

props.doc: A short note at the end (a shortcut).
False dims it and stops presses.

widget.doc: The menu of a right click or a "more" button: actions with icons and shortcuts, hairlines between groups. Fires onSelected with the label.

props.doc: The actions' labels; "-" is a hairline.

widget.doc: The menu that picks what a list is sorted by and which way. The choice and the direction (asc or desc) are kept in your variables. Fires onChanged and onDirectionChanged.

props.doc: The name of your text variable holding the choice.
The name of your text variable holding asc or desc.

widget.doc: The account menu: who is signed in, a few actions and Sign out. Fires onSelected with the label, and onSignOut.
One connection in a StatusCardList: a letter plate, a name, a line about it and a pill telling whether it is connected. Fires onConfigure.

props.doc: The plate letter's color (empty: secondary text).
A hairline over it (every row but the first).

widget.doc: A list of connections with when they were last checked and a refresh button. Its children are StatusCard calls. Fires onRefresh.

props.doc: When it was last checked (empty: no line).

widget.doc: A history of runs: its children are RunRecordRow calls (divider: true after the first). Empty shows a quiet message in their place.

props.doc: Nothing ran yet: the message shows.

props.default: Runs will show here as they finish.

widget.doc: Several short facts shown one at a time, with arrows and dots to step through them. Which one shows is kept in your number variable.

props.doc: The name of your number variable holding which fact shows (0 first).

widget.doc: What happened over time, as cards down a rail: an event, when, and a note each. The chosen event is kept in your variable. Fires onSelected.

props.doc: The name of your text variable holding the chosen event.

bind.props.style.color: ${= (length(props.levels) > index ? props.levels[index] : 'info') == 'error' ? '#99FF7B72' : ((length(props.levels) > index ? props.levels[index] : 'info') == 'warn' ?
